temptations.text: Did not treat the kitchen and bathroom Google reviews as proof that kitchens and baths are the primary advertised work; the site's own headline and service list are general contracting.
The About page states 'Founded and led by Jose Rivas', but G6 was not reached, so no decision_maker was recorded.

Did not count the 'Expires 09/30/2026' offer banner as site_dated_content (it is a promotion, not a project/blog/gallery addition).

Did not count the careers page's 'Always Accepting Carpenters' as a live dated job posting; it carries no date.

Did not treat the kitchen and bathroom '-lp' landing pages as proof that kitchen/bath is the primary advertised work; the H1, title tag ('General Contractor in Greenwich CT') and 15-service list position it as a general contractor.

About page states 'Heading the firm is Richard R. Barr, NJCID'; G6 was not reached, so no decision_maker was recorded ('heading the firm' would also need checking against the owner/president wording rule).

The contact address is rendered by Joomla's JavaScript email cloak as entity-encoded fragments ('i' + ... + '@' + 'plumberry' ...); the full address string does not appear on the page, so no email was assembled or recorded.
Did not date the 'WE'VE MOVED' relocation from the image file's Last-Modified header as a trigger; the page itself carries no date.
Did not treat the GC-written Google review ('As a GC, we partnered with Richard of Plumberry Designs') as proof that Plumberry performs construction.
Did not treat the high count of bathroom blog posts as the firm's primary advertised work; blog topics are SEO content and the meta description and service menu lead with custom homes and additions.

Footer shows 'info@windledc.com' and address '450 W. Gay St, West Chester' (GBP shows 331 W Miner St); G6 was not reached, so neither email nor address discrepancy was assessed as a relocation trigger.
Did not read the team page for owner roles because G6 was not reached; no decision maker recorded.

The email local part 'talha' was not treated as belonging to Taha A. Gursoy; no page states that this address is his.
Bethesda showroom opening date not stated anywhere fetched; not counted as a 2026 new-showroom trigger.

The site lists 'Kitchen Remodeling' and 'Bathroom Remodeling' first in the menu; menu order was not taken as evidence that they are the primary advertised work.
kathy robinson review '3 months ago' could fall before 2026-07-16; not counted.
No DBPR record under the business name does not establish that no one at the firm is licensed; not used as evidence for or against the firm.
The H1 mentions 'Kitchen Remodels & Bathroom Renovations', but the site's own specialty statement and title lead with custom homes; kitchen/bath was not treated as primary work.

'In Association With Gruenthal Construction' was not treated as a corporate parent; G5 was not run.

No owner or principal is named on any site page (home, about-us, contact, getting-started, location, review, products, policies); decision_maker left null rather than drawn from registries.
Permit project costs ($37k-$86k) are public-record values, not a published average project value; not used as the high_ticket evidence.

Kitchen Remodeling and Bathroom Remodeling are the first two listed services, but the title tag and hero position the firm as a house-flipping/turnkey investor contractor; not treated as kitchen/bath primary.

Chris Harrin (President) is also a decision maker per the team page; Jay Cope recorded as first listed.
